name: Muc tuoi
summary: Squid hand-lined from small day-boats and still moving when it reaches the tank. Cooked, it is crisp with a deep sweet taste.
howToEat: Pick it fresh at the night market and have the stall grill or steam it.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Muc tuoi — fresh squid in Con Dao
seoDescription: Fresh squid in Côn Đảo is hand-lined from day-boats, crisp and deeply sweet when cooked at the night market.
